inspiration.observed_pattern: EXTRACTVALUE returns text selected by an XPath over an XML document, including repeated and positional child nodes.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reduced to one independently authored XML literal and two scalar XPath projections, isolating repeated-node concatenation and positional selection without table state or migration logic.

fixture_notes: The fixed document has two item nodes; the first projection returns both labels separated by a space and the second returns only the second state.
determinism_notes: The XML literal and XPath expressions are fixed; no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections are used.
